notes.title: Our Biggest Discount + Yuri Bundle Update
notes.notes:
This week, for the first time, A Little Lily Princess is 75% off on Steam! If you've been on the fence before, now is the best time to pick it up.

We also have special bundle offers for buying yuri-themed games together at an extra discount, and today have added a new entry to that bundle:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1085/Hanako_Yuri_Bundle/

Purchase together with A Little Lily Princess for extra savings!

notes.notes:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/449250/discussions/0/143388511228558655/

Please go there for any questions or to report any problems.
